assessments.bilingual: 几千斤重的一个橄榄 remains an olive weighing thousands of catties. Thousands is deliberately immoderate, not a literal plausible olive weight. No quantity, colour word, quoted couplet or remembered scene changed.
assessments.literary: The tactile, oral olive simile connects poetic words to Caltrop’s felt comprehension. Keeping its extravagant heaviness rather than explaining it away preserves the voice and the transition from the straight/round discussion in b23 to poetic adaptation in b25. The slightly unusual olive remains unusual by design.
assessments.consistency: Catties matches earlier10b29/42b32 and own83 numeric-mass usage. This separately selected token does not broaden the original25/53 sixteen-token decision.

assessments.bilingual: All eight masses remain 200 assorted fish, 20 deer sinews, 50 sea cucumbers, 20 dried razor clams, 200 dried shrimps, 1000 selected best-grade silver-frost charcoal, 2000 medium-grade charcoal, and 30000 firewood/charcoal, now in catties. Each/aggregate distinctions, animal pairs, sacks, shi, hu and 2500 taels retain their original wording and order.
assessments.literary: The long semicolon inventory still accumulates household abundance while Jia Rong’s good-luck remark and Wu Jin-xiao’s deferential appearance bracket it. Changing only the eight repeated mass nouns does not abridge the list, smooth away its historical categories or spoil the numerical rhythm.
assessments.consistency: Every changed mass is plural, so catties is grammatical. No species or modern metric certainty is added. Wu Jin-xiao is not a weight token and remains unchanged.

assessments.bilingual: 叫芳官唱一出《寻梦》 is still the instruction for the same girl to sing Seeking the Dream. Only Fang-guan becomes Parfumée. The twelve girls, Wen-guan and Kui-guan, separate visiting troupe, play order and restrained accompaniment all remain unchanged.
assessments.literary: The matriarch’s teasing theatrical expertise and Wen-guan’s tactful reply survive word for word. Parfumée is a name already witnessed in the author’s own later chapter, not an explanatory insertion about fragrance or future events. The intimate performance scene is not made to foretell later dismissal or marriage.
assessments.consistency: Own81 source-unit12 explicitly pairs 芳官 with Parfumée in a recollection of the former girls. This is sufficient internal project name continuity, not external translation authority. The exact r2 b30 remembrance and b34 self-deprecating joke remain intact.

assessments.bilingual: A few catties of oil, forty-eight catties of oil, one catty of wick-rushes, twenty-four catties of oil and five catties preserve the five explicit English unit tokens. The inherited ellipsis or three, or one is grammatical and does not require inserting extra unit nouns.
assessments.literary: Mother Ma’s reassuring It costs very little leads into increasingly grand donor examples and a vat-sized lamp. The same manipulative contrast and flattering living Bodhisattvas remain; the mass spelling neither modernizes the offer nor recalculates its expense.
assessments.consistency: Four plural forms and one singular one catty match earlier project usage. The live accepted text and its three reviews still cover jin; this independent evidence binds only the new proposed body.

assessments.bilingual: Half a catty, seven catties and five catties a day preserve the three explicit English tokens. Four taels of oil, the five-at-least ellipsis, monthly collection and strings of cash for alms are unchanged; no mass/money relation is recomputed.
assessments.literary: The feigned caution that too much generosity could diminish Bao-yu’s blessings still turns into the agreed daily offering. Grandmother Jia’s exact decision and Mother Ma’s pious exit into further scrounging in b14 retain the irony without narrator-added accusation.
assessments.consistency: Half a takes singular catty. The seven/five plural expressions agree with the rule; this is a project style alignment, not a claim that the old jin was an intrinsic mistranslation.
